summary.business_type: B2B service agency (AI automation) with programmatic comparison content and a free calculator
top_findings: www and http hostnames return 200 with no redirect to https://rzautomate.com
Homepage stats, results and testimonials are placeholders
White text on the coral brand colour is 3.47:1, below WCAG AA
Model and tool pages have a crawlability bug (anchor without href) and an invalid definition list
No About page or case studies; Organization sameAs is empty; blog is mostly off-topic LMS content
quick_wins: 301 www to apex and http to https in Cloudflare
Render the last breadcrumb as a span, not an anchor
Fix the model hero dl/dt/dd structure
Add LinkedIn and GitHub to Organization sameAs

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt and sitemap correct (50 URLs, lastmod)

findings.title: www host not redirected
findings.description: https://www.rzautomate.com returns 200.
findings.recommendation: 301 to the apex domain.

findings.title: http not redirected to https
findings.description: http://rzautomate.com returns 200.
findings.recommendation: Enable Always Use HTTPS or a redirect rule.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Other security headers are present.
findings.recommendation: Add report-only CSP, then enforce.

findings.title: /design deployed publicly
findings.description: Noindexed and disallowed, but reachable.
findings.recommendation: Exclude from production builds.

findings.title: Placeholder homepage proof
findings.description: Stats, results and testimonials are placeholders per code comments.
findings.recommendation: Replace with measured results or remove.

findings.title: No About page or case studies
findings.description: Weak E-E-A-T trust signals.
findings.recommendation: Publish an About page and real case studies.

findings.title: Off-topic blog
findings.description: Three of four posts cover LMS and e-learning.
findings.recommendation: Add AI automation posts; review the others.

findings.title: Unverified model prices
findings.description: Pages state prices were checked on November 14, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Verify against providers and publish an update schedule.

findings.title: Thin listing pages
findings.description: /services 206 words, /blog 239, /contact 291.
findings.recommendation: Add short intros.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 and unique title and description on every page
lang, viewport, Open Graph and Twitter tags everywhere

findings.title: Long titles and descriptions
findings.description: 16 titles at 66 to 70 characters; two descriptions at 174.
findings.recommendation: Trim to about 60 and about 155.

findings.title: Single default share image
findings.description: All pages share one Open Graph image.
findings.recommendation: Add per-page images for models and tools.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization, Person, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Service, BlogPosting, Dataset, WebApplication

findings.title: Organization sameAs empty
findings.description: No profile links on the organization entity.
findings.recommendation: Add LinkedIn and GitHub.

findings.title: FAQPage rich results unlikely
findings.description: Google restricts FAQ rich results; markup is still harmless.
findings.recommendation: No action.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Lighthouse performance 99 to 100 on five page types
LCP 1.1 to 2.0 s, CLS 0, TBT 0 to 60 ms

findings.title: Unused JavaScript
findings.description: About 57 KiB on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Split or defer unused client code.

findings.title: No field data
findings.description: CrUX unavailable; PageSpeed API quota exceeded.
findings.recommendation: Re-check after traffic builds.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Markdown mirror for every page and content negotiation

findings.title: Weak third-party authority signals
findings.description: Empty sameAs, no case studies or About page.
findings.recommendation: Build brand profiles and published results.

findings.title: Oversized service thumbnails
findings.description: 94 to 136 KB at 1672 px wide, shown at about 360 px.
findings.recommendation: Serve responsive variants with srcset.

findings.title: Insufficient contrast on coral
findings.description: White on #ff4133 is 3.47:1; translucent white on coral is 2.66 to 2.84:1.
findings.recommendation: Darken coral to about #E03227 or use dark text.

findings.title: Anchor without href
findings.description: Last breadcrumb item on model and tool pages is not crawlable.
findings.recommendation: Use a span with aria-current.

findings.title: Invalid definition list
findings.description: Model hero dl has a wrapper div around dd.
findings.recommendation: Place dt and dd directly in dl groups.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Legal review of terms and privacy

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Keep price dates and llms.txt current
